title: Pacific Beach Bar Tour in San Diego
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
21+ event. Valid ID must be presented for entry to each club. Passports required for international guests.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
4 bars in 1 night is the plan - YOU GOT THIS!!

Party along the beach & discover the most popular bars in San Diego's PACIFIC BEACH area!

HERE'S THE PLAN: No line, no cover + exclusive drink specials through the entire night!!

You'll start things off just steps away from the ocean & sand, at our meeting location: THRUSTERS! Here you'll receive you FREE welcome kit (including VIP wristband, drink ticket, & LED ring) and have a chance to mingle with others in the group.

From there we'll turn up the WILD and soak in the good vibes at the second bar HIDEWAY.

Next up, we'll continue the excitement by singing along & groove to an always upbeat DJ at the third bar, MAVERICKS.

Lastly, we'll settle in & dance the night away with nightclub vibes at either BREAK POINT -or- PB AVENUE - which both boast spacious dance floors, DJ lighting, & bass pumping music!! 

AN EPIC NIGHT OUT AWAITS!!!
